gloss: upper level; upper tier; high position

definitions.gloss: upper level; upper tier; upper row
definitions.explanation: The upper section of something divided into levels, such as a shelf, display case, or seating area.
In martial arts (especially kendo), the stance where the sword or weapon is held high above the head, ready to strike downward.

examples.english: To put it on the upper shelf.

notes:
Part of a three-level system used to describe vertical positions or martial arts stances. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧ (joke).

THREE-LEVEL SYSTEM:
- {上段|じょうだん}: upper level
- {中段|ちゅうだん}: middle level
- ⟦{下段|げだん}→下段：25995_gedan⟧: lower level

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上段|じょうだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: upper shelf
- {上段|じょうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to take a high guard stance
- {上段|じょうだん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{振|ふ}り{下|お}ろす: to swing down from a high position
- {上段|じょうだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{間|ま}: the upper chamber (in traditional architecture, the elevated section of a room for honored guests)
